name: memory
description: Long-term memory skills for a coding agent on a Hindsight memory bank: situate (catch up before work), remember and learn (save a source or a researched synthesis), and sweep (save what landed before a session closes).

interface.shortDescription: Catch up, remember, research, and sweep with a Hindsight memory bank.
interface.longDescription: Skills that use a Hindsight memory bank the environment already connects: situate loads what is known before work resumes, remember saves a stated fact or a handed-over document with its source, learn researches a topic and saves the synthesis marked as research, and sweep saves what landed before a session closes or compacts. The rules live in one backend-neutral conventions file and one Hindsight binding.
interface.defaultPrompt: Get up to speed on this project from memory.
